proves.claim: On a fresh board with pace sprint, after submit --no-next and no reviewer command, show prints merged as and list gives the item a merged commit while its status is still submitted.

cli.sprint.lands-without-accept.why: Without it a sprint item could still wait for an accept, as every proof board showed before the wiring.

proves.claim: On a steady board the submitted item does not land without an accept and lands after one, as before.

cli.sprint.steady-waits-for-accept.why: Sprint wiring must change nothing for steady boards.
